$comment: Maps a feature tag to the resource its scenarios need exclusively. Two scenarios that map to the same resource never run at the same time in the parallel profile.
Every Prop Room feature maps to 'prop-room-seed': each scenario resets the API's global seed data before it starts, so two of them running together would reset each other's data.
The framework demos use the per-worker fake API and the example database rows they own, so they get resources of their own and run in parallel with the rest.
A feature tag that is not listed is exclusive to itself: its scenarios never overlap with each other.
